target: Dr. Casey Means, MD - co-founder of Levels Health, author of 'Good Energy'
summary: Profile-level metadata was successfully retrieved from the public og:description meta tag. Individual post/reel data (shortcodes, captions, likes, views, dates) could NOT be retrieved: every logged-out endpoint is now login-walled, rate-limited (HTTP 429), or blocked. No post-level records were recovered by any of the 7 methods.

profile.biography: #1 NYT Bestselling Author: Good Energy / Writing to 200,000 in my Tuesday newsletter / Co-founder @levels / Working toward a healthy + limitless world

1_reels_html.note: Page returns 200 but is a logged-out app shell. The 36 embedded JSON blobs are Bloks/app config and contain no reel media items. window._sharedData and window.__additionalDataLoaded are absent (long deprecated).

2_picuki.note: Cloudflare interstitial: 'Sorry, you have been blocked'. Picuki sits behind a Cloudflare security challenge that rejects non-browser clients.

3_instaloader.error: ProfileNotExistsException: Profile drcaseyskitchen does not exist.
3_instaloader.note: Not a real 'does not exist' - this is Instagram's standard anti-anonymous-scraping response to instaloader's unauthenticated profile query. Instaloader requires a logged-in session to fetch this profile.

4_profile_html.og_description: 844K Followers, 368 Following, 846 Posts - See Instagram photos and videos from Casey Means, MD (@drcaseyskitchen)
4_profile_html.note: Profile counts parsed from og:description. No embedded timeline/post JSON - logged-out profile HTML no longer ships post data.

web_profile_info.note: Rate-limited even with a warmed-up session (csrftoken/datr/ig_did/mid cookies set). Empty body. One polite retry after 8s also returned 429.

graphql_query.note: 403 Forbidden. Also skipped in-script because no profile id could be obtained from the rate-limited web_profile_info call.

6_feed.note: Returns the standard Instagram HTML web app shell, not an RSS/Atom document. Instagram does not expose a public RSS feed for profiles.

7_webcache.note: Returns a Google JavaScript-redirect/'enable JS' page, not a cached snapshot. Google retired the webcache: feature, so no Instagram snapshot is available here.

conclusion: As of this run, scraping Instagram post/reel data for @drcaseyskitchen without an authenticated session is not possible. Reliable options going forward: (1) the official Instagram Graph API with a Business/Creator account and access token, (2) instaloader configured with a logged-in session (L.login() or load_session_from_file), or (3) a headless browser (Playwright/Selenium) with valid Instagram cookies. Only public profile-level metadata (follower/following/post counts, name, bio) is currently retrievable anonymously.
